Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical disambiguation error in Step 2. Upon receiving initial search results that clearly identified "Aurora (2018 Filipino film)" directed by Yam Laranas, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the film corresponded to multiple entries and arbitrarily selected the Finnish drama directed by Miia Tervo. This decision was flawed because the search results explicitly showed the 2018 Filipino film as a primary match (with an IMDb link and Wikipedia entry), whereas the Finnish film "Aurora" was released in 2019. By ignoring the clear evidence of the 2018 film in the search results and forcing the search down the path of the 2019 film, the Planner introduced the wrong subject into the task, leading to the incorrect birthplace of Rovaniemi instead of the correct answer, Davao (the birthplace of Yam Laranas).
